message.content:
I don’t have access to live traffic feeds, so I can’t give you a real‑time snapshot of congestion in New York right now.  

If you need up‑to‑date traffic conditions, the best options are:

| Service | How to use it |
|---------|---------------|
| **Google Maps** | Open the app or website, type “New York” or your specific route, and tap the “Traffic” layer. |
| **Waze** | Launch the app, set your destination, and the map will show current traffic speeds and incidents. |
| **City or state DOT** | Many metropolitan transportation agencies publish live traffic cams and incident reports on their websites (e.g., NYC DOT). |
| **Apple Maps** | On iOS, open the app, search for “New York,” and the traffic overlay will appear automatically. |

If you’re planning a trip or need estimates, you can also check the average travel times for your usual routes on these platforms. Let me know if you’d like help navigating any of them!
